% =========================================================================
% TABLE: SVC Parameters — 33-Bus Test System
% Requires: \usepackage{booktabs, siunitx, multirow, threeparttable}
% =========================================================================

\begin{table}[htbp]
\centering
\caption{Parameters of the Static VAr Compensators in the 33-Bus Test System}
\label{tab:svc_parameters}
\begin{threeparttable}
\renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.25}
\begin{tabular}{lcccc}
\toprule
\textbf{Parameter} 
    & \textbf{SVC\,1} 
    & \textbf{SVC\,2} 
    & \textbf{SVC\,3} \\
\midrule

Bus number                                  & 11        & 17        & 32        \\
Firing angle $\alpha$ (deg)                 & 150 (fixed) & 90–180  & 90–180    \\
Control variable                            & —         & $\alpha_2$& $\alpha_1$\\

\midrule
\multicolumn{4}{l}{\textit{TCR (Thyristor-Controlled Reactor) — per phase}} \\
\midrule

Inductance $L$\,(mH)                        & 5.300     & 2.500     & 2.650     \\
Resistance $R$\,($\Omega$)                  & 0.001     & 0.001     & 0.001     \\
Reactance $X_L = \omega L$\,($\Omega$)      & 1.998     & 0.942     & 0.999     \\
Reactance $X_L$\,(pu)\tnote{a}             & 0.01247   & 0.00588   & 0.00623   \\

\midrule
\multicolumn{4}{l}{\textit{Fixed Capacitor Bank (FC) — per phase}} \\
\midrule

Capacitance $C$\,($\mu$F)                   & 2652.6    & 2652.6    & 2652.6    \\
Reactance $X_C = 1/\omega C$\,($\Omega$)    & 1.000     & 1.000     & 1.000     \\
Reactance $X_C$\,(pu)\tnote{a}             & 0.00624   & 0.00624   & 0.00624   \\

\midrule
\multicolumn{4}{l}{\textit{Reactive Power Rating — three-phase (obtained from harmonic power flow)}} \\
\midrule

$Q_{\min}$\,(kVAR)\tnote{b}                & —\tnote{c} & $-231.4$  & $-117.1$  \\
$Q_{\max}$\,(kVAR)\tnote{d}                & —\tnote{c} & $+3210.8$ & $+3065.1$ \\
Control range $\Delta Q$\,(kVAR)            & —         & $3442.2$  & $3182.2$  \\

\bottomrule
\end{tabular}

\begin{tablenotes}
\footnotesize
\item[a] Per-unit values on system base: $S_b = 1$\,MVA, $V_b = 12.66$\,kV,
         $Z_b = V_b^2/S_b = 160.28\,\Omega$.
\item[b] $Q_{\min}$ corresponds to $\alpha = 90°$ (full TCR conduction); 
         negative sign indicates inductive (absorbing) operation.
\item[c] SVC\,1 operates at a fixed firing angle ($\alpha = 150°$) and is 
         not subject to optimization; its reactive power is implicitly 
         embedded in the bus injection results.
\item[d] $Q_{\max}$ corresponds to $\alpha = 180°$ (TCR fully blocked); 
         positive sign indicates capacitive (generating) operation.
\end{tablenotes}

\end{threeparttable}
\end{table}

% =========================================================================
% NOTE ON TOPOLOGY:
% All three SVCs follow the FC-TCR (Fixed Capacitor + Thyristor-Controlled
% Reactor) configuration. The capacitive and inductive reactances of SVC\,2
% and SVC\,3 are nearly equal (X_L ≈ X_C ≈ 1.0 Ω), confirming that the
% reactor and capacitor are tuned to the fundamental frequency, yielding
% near-zero net reactive power at full TCR conduction (α = 90°).
% =========================================================================
